title.zh: 从我的笔记里找 5 个选题
title.en: Find five topics in your notes

body.zh: 从你最近的笔记里挖反常识、亲身经历和读者常问的选题。
body.en: Mine your recent notes for surprising findings, personal stories and reader questions.

prompt.zh: 从我的笔记里找 5 个有素材支撑的选题。
prompt.en: Find five content topics supported by material in my notes.

body.zh: 按“场景开头、三个观点、读者能马上做的一件事”搭好长文结构。
body.en: Structure a long post: an opening scene, three points, one thing readers can do now.

title.zh: 每周一自动生成选题池

body.zh: 每周一早上，从上周笔记里整理 5 张选题卡放进收件箱。
body.en: Every Monday morning, five topic cards from last week’s notes land in your inbox.
